limitations: The headline and reconciliation tables put 2024 before 2025 and the relevant 2025 three-month value at numeric index 1; the GAAP appendix puts 2025 first at index 0. Six-/nine-month cumulative columns are excluded.

Adjusted income from operations is company-defined non-GAAP and must not be equated with GAAP net income. The selected reconciliation total equals the sum of listed signed components; the subsidiary-sale line is shown as an em dash in both current 2025 quarters and is not separately recorded as an audited numeric zero.

GAAP revenue rose while GAAP net income and adjusted income from operations declined. The GAAP-to-adjusted gap narrowed sharply; signed fair-value/reinsurance and other-items adjustment components changed substantially, but this selected bridge does not prove their recurrence or economic cause.
Preferred dividends are a signed deduction in the selected appendix. A larger deduction contributes to the larger decline in common-stockholder diluted income than in consolidated net income.
Selected rows do not audit every segment, reserve assumption, investment portfolio exposure, capital adequacy, or all reconciliation footnotes.

reviews.rationale: Selected SEC exhibit rows show a sequential quarter in which GAAP earnings and company-defined adjusted operating earnings both moved lower while GAAP revenues moved higher, so the revenue direction and the profit direction diverge and the selected rows do not reconcile them. The reconciliation rows indicate that the composition of company-defined adjustments changed materially between the two quarters, with fair value reinsurance-related and other items swinging to negative and partly offset by smaller investment losses and a smaller life product feature charge; the tax line on adjustments also moved in a direction that is not a smaller tax drag. Because the selected rows are pre-tax reconciliation components and headline subtotals only, they do not establish which drivers caused the GAAP or adjusted decline, and the adjusted-versus-GAAP gap cannot be attributed without the full reconciliation and segment detail. The thesis carries no assumptions, catalysts or invalidation conditions, so no stated condition was triggered or cleared. The appropriate research state is a hold for review: the evidence is directionally informative but insufficient to support a defensible upgrade, downgrade or invalidation, and the thesis remains blocked pending complete filing detail, segment and reserve development disclosure, and management explanation of the fair value reinsurance and other-item swings.
